transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I know the new owners are out to destroy my name, no matter what anyone says. They are actively working behind the scenes to ruin my reputation, and I need people to understand what's really going on.
How long have you been feeling that the new owners are trying to ruin your reputation, and did this start suddenly or has it been going on for a long time?

It started about two months ago, right around the time the new owners cut my hours and I sank into this really dark, drained state. Before these last two months, I never had any of these thoughts about people trying to sabotage me or ruin my name.
During these last two months, have you also had any hallucinations, like hearing voices or seeing things that other people do not?
No, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there. But what the owners are doing to sabotage my reputation is absolutely real, and it's not just my imagination.
During these past two months, have you also been feeling depressed most days, losing interest or pleasure in things, or having trouble sleeping or eating?

Yes, for the last two months, I've completely lost interest in photography and running, and everything just feels totally pointless. I'm barely sleeping, waking up at 3 AM with my mind racing, and I've lost a lot of weight because I have no appetite and have to force myself to eat.
Have these symptoms of depression and the belief that people are trying to ruin your reputation been present for less than 1 month, or have they lasted longer than that?

They've been going on for longer than a month—it's been about two months now. It all started right after they cut my hours and gave that promotion to the younger bartender, and it hasn't let up since. I just feel completely exhausted by all of it.
During these past two months, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. I do feel extremely low and drained, but it's more that I feel like I deserve to be punished for all of my failures.

Besides the belief that the owners are trying to ruin your reputation, have you had any other unusual beliefs, such as feeling guilty in an extreme way, feeling that your thoughts are being broadcast, or believing you are especially powerful or important?

I don't believe I have special powers or that my thoughts are being broadcast, but I do feel an overwhelming sense of guilt. I'm convinced all of this is entirely my fault and that I must have done something terrible to deserve losing my job, my bar plans, and my friends. It just feels like the universe is finally punishing me for every past mistake I've ever made.
Have you ever felt so guilty or hopeless that you believed you deserved to be punished, or that you were worthless or had ruined everything, even when others told you that wasn’t true?

Yes, absolutely. No matter what my friends say to reassure me, I feel completely worthless and convinced that I've ruined everything. I'm certain I must have done something terrible to deserve losing my job, my dream lounge, and my friends, and that the universe is just punishing me.
Do you ever feel completely unable to move or speak, or become so slowed down or agitated that other people notice it?

I haven't really experienced being completely frozen or unable to speak. I do feel incredibly heavy and exhausted all the time, like my body is made of concrete, but I can still move when I absolutely have to.
Do you believe the owners are trying to ruin your reputation even when there is clear evidence that this is not true, or do you think this feeling only happens when your mood is at its lowest?

Even when people tell me it's not true or call me paranoid, I still feel absolutely certain they are sabotaging me behind the scenes. However, this certainty and these thoughts only started happening after I fell into this dark, hopeless state a couple of months ago. Before my mood crashed like this, I never had these kinds of ideas.
Have you ever had any of these beliefs or feelings when your mood was normal, or do they only happen during this depressed period?

No, I've never had these thoughts when my mood was normal. They only started after I fell into this dark, drained state about two months ago. Before my mood crashed like this, I never felt like anyone was trying to sabotage my reputation.
Have you ever had these fixed beliefs or any other unusual thoughts when you were not depressed, or do they only happen during this depressed period?

No, I have never had these thoughts or beliefs when my mood was normal. They only started after I had already fallen into this dark, exhausted, and hopeless state over the last two months. Before this depression hit, I never believed anyone was trying to sabotage me.
